name: Montana

jury_list.statute: MCA 3-15-403(2): 'An excerpt, listing the name, address, and birth year of all jurors, must be made available for public inspection during normal business hours.' Uniform District Court Rule 9(a) (MCA 25-19-101): completed juror questionnaires 'will only be available to the parties, the attorneys for the parties, judges and court employees. Others requesting the completed forms must file a Request for Privacy Information with the court.' No section opens or closes records of persons found not qualified as non-citizens. Status: null.
jury_list.holder: Clerk of the district court (jury commissioner, MCA 3-15-404).

sources.cite: MCA 3-15-403(2) (public excerpt of jury lists: name, address, birth year; disqualification records not addressed)

Uniform District Court Rule 9(a), MCA 25-19-101 (completed juror questionnaires available only to parties, attorneys, judges and court employees; others must file a Request for Privacy Information; destroyed after the jury term)
MCA 3-15-301(3) (a juror must be 'a citizen of the United States')

voter_file.who_may_get: Any individual, for noncommercial use, from the Secretary of State or the local election administrator, at actual cost (MCA 13-2-122(1)). Protected addresses are withheld (13-2-122(2)).

private_challenge.who: Any registered elector, at any time (MCA 13-13-301(1)).
private_challenge.form_or_statute: MCA 13-13-301: signed affidavit stating the grounds plus supporting evidence, filed with the election administrator (Secretary of State standardized form, 13-13-301(5)). Grounds include 'does not meet another requirement provided in the constitution or by law' (13-13-301(2)(h)); U.S. citizenship is a statutory voter qualification (MCA 13-1-111(1)(d)).
private_challenge.deadlines: No filing deadline. Before the close of regular registration the administrator questions both sides and decides on cancellation; after it, the challenged elector casts a provisional ballot (13-13-301(3)).
private_challenge.evidence_standard: Affidavit stating the grounds and 'any evidence supporting the challenge' (13-13-301(1)). The challenged elector receives a copy of the affidavit and evidence and learns who made the challenge (13-13-301(4)).

sources.cite: MCA 13-1-111(1)(d) (a voter must be a U.S. citizen)

county_board.name: Montana election administrators contact list (Secretary of State)
county_board.note: Challenges under MCA 13-13-301 go to the county election administrator.

state_election_office.name: Montana Secretary of State - Elections and Voter Services

audit_path.statute: MCA 2-6-1003 (right to inspect public information; Mont. Const. art. II, sec. 9) and 52 U.S.C. 20507(i) (NVRA public inspection of list-maintenance records)
audit_path.what_you_can_request: Counts only, from the county election administrator or the Secretary of State: per year, the number of registrations cancelled under MCA 13-2-402(8) because the elector failed to meet the citizenship qualification in 13-1-111, and the number of challenge affidavits filed under 13-13-301 on that ground.
audit_path.note: Do not ask for names. No Montana statute sends juror citizenship answers to election officials. Whether the Secretary of State keeps counts by cancellation reason was not confirmed.

gates.basis: Jury disqualification records: no statute opens or closes them (null), so counts only. The public excerpt (3-15-403(2)) lists jurors, not persons found not qualified; questionnaires are limited by Rule 9. Any registered elector may file a challenge affidavit with evidence at any time (MCA 13-13-301). Strict gates.

notes: CHANGED 2026-10-07: applied under Optimus standing rule (no gate loosens). jury_list statute quoted exactly (3-15-403(2), Uniform District Court Rule 9(a)); jury sources Rule 9 and 3-15-301 added; audit_path; federal_source_url moved to govinfo. jury_list.public stays null. official_pipeline stays null. No voter_file value changes.

PA-style check: 3-15-403(2) makes public an excerpt with 'the name, address, and birth year of all jurors'. That is a list of jurors, with no disqualification reason. Rule 9 limits completed questionnaires to the parties, attorneys, judges and court employees. No section creates a public list of non-citizen excusals.

official_pipeline is null: no Montana statute sends juror citizenship answers to election officials. MCA 13-2-402(8) requires cancellation if 'the elector fails to meet any voter qualification that is listed in 13-1-111', but names no jury source. The Secretary of State announced SAVE checks of the whole roll (KTVH, 2025); that is practice, not a jury pipeline.
Cancelled-voter file: no published Montana cancelled-voter file with a jury reason code was found. REQ-NOTE 27 drops cancelled rows before matching.
The challenger's name, affidavit, and evidence are given to the challenged elector (13-13-301(4)).
one_per_affidavit, false_statement_penalty, dob_in_public_file, and registration_date_in_public_file are null: not stated in the sections read.
